configurations.name: plan-map
configurations.comment: Serves the repo root so docs/design/echo-plan-map.html can fetch ../../ROADMAP.md live (opened as a file it cannot). Then open /docs/design/echo-plan-map.html. The page stores nothing, so the port is free to move. python3 -m http.server takes the port positionally and does not read $PORT, hence the sh -c wrapper.
